# Init MQ
mq = MQ(config.message_queue)
try:
    mq.startup()
except:
    os._exit(1)

# Init DB
backend = Backend.instance()
backend.init(config.database, Path(__file__).parent / "migrations")

preset_manager = PresetManager.instance()
preset_manager.set_presets(config.presets)
preset_manager.load_all()

messageQueue = asyncio.Queue()

plat = Platform.instance()
plat.start_monitor()

model_cache = ModelCache(options=config.model_cache)
Singleton.set(ModelCache, model_cache)

gpu = GPUWatchdog(config.gpu_watchdog)
gpu.start()

# TODO remove this in future all infos are already in monitor_platform
def monitor_gpu():
    gpu_queue = gpu.results()
    hostname = gethostname()
    key = f"gpu:status:{hostname}"
    max_items = config.gpu_watchdog.max_items

    kill_when_cuda_offline = config.gpu_watchdog.kill_when_cuda_offline

    while True:
        entry: GPUWatchdogStatus = gpu_queue.get()
        if entry is None:
            break
